title: Think Locally, Refine Globally for Memory-Efficient 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose LoG-VGGT, a memory-efficient framework for long-sequence 3D reconstruction that balances local temporal modeling with global camera consistency. Instead of relying on full global attention, our method introduces cross-window attention at a small subset of transformer blocks, enabling effective information propagation across adjacent temporal windows while keeping memory usage bounded. To mitigate long-term pose drift, we further design a global camera consistency refinement module, where camera tokens interact with compact register tokens via cross-attention to enforce scene-level constraints across the entire sequence. This design enables joint optimization of camera representations and significantly improves long-horizon pose stability without incurring the high cost of sequence-wide attention. translated_title: 局部思考，全局优化：面向内存高效的三维重建
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LoG-VGGT，一个面向长序列三维重建的内存高效框架，它平衡了局部时序建模与全局相机一致性。我们的方法不依赖完全的全局注意力，而是在一小部分transformer块中引入跨窗口注意力，使信息能够在相邻的时间窗口之间有效传播，同时将内存使用保持在有界范围内。为了缓解长期位姿漂移，我们进一步设计了一个全局相机一致性优化模块，其中相机token通过交叉注意力与紧凑的寄存器token进行交互，从而在整个序列上施加场景级约束。这一设计实现了相机表示的联合优化，并显著提升了长时序下的位姿稳定性，而无需承担序列级全局注意力的高昂成本。大量实验表明，LoG-VGGT在多个场景中实现了更高的深度精度和鲁棒的相机位姿估计。
tldr: 提出LoG-VGGT框架，通过在少量transformer块中引入跨窗口注意力，并结合基于寄存器token的全局相机一致性优化模块，在内存有界的情况下实现长序列三维重建的高精度深度估计与稳定相机位姿。
en_tdlr: LoG-VGGT enables memory-efficient long-sequence 3D reconstruction by introducing cross-window attention in a small subset of transformer blocks combined with a global camera consistency refinement module using register tokens, achieving improved depth accuracy and robust pose estimation without the high cost of sequence-wide attention.
